verses.geez:
ወከመዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ልደቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ኖኅ ፡ ሴም ፡ ወካም ፡ ወያፌት ፡ ወተወልደ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡
                  አይኅ ።
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noe, Sem, Cham, Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.

translations.lxx: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noe, Sem, Cham, Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.
translations.kjv: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
translations.ron: Iată spiţa neamului fiilor lui Noe: Sem, Ham şi Iafet, cărora li s-au născut fii după potop.
translations.grk: Αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις τῶν υἱῶν Νῶε, Σὴμ, Χὰμ, Ἰάφεθ· καὶ ἐγεννήθησαν αὐτοῖς υἱοὶ μετὰ τὸν κατακλυσμόν.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ ፡ ያፌት ፡ ጋሜር ፡ ወያጎግ ፡ ወማዴ ፡ ወይህያን ፡ ወኤልሳ ፡ ወቶቤል ፡ ወሞሳኅ ፡ ወቲራ ።
verses.translation: The sons of Japheth, Gamer, and Magog, and Madoi, and Jovan, and Elisa, and Thobel, and Mosoch, and Thiras.

translations.lxx: The sons of Japheth, Gamer, and Magog, and Madoi, and Jovan, and Elisa, and Thobel, and Mosoch, and Thiras.
translations.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
translations.ron: Fii lui Iafet au fost: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Iavan, Tubal, Meşeh şi Tiras.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἰάφεθ, Γαμὲρ, καὶ Μαγὼγ, καὶ Μαδοὶ, καὶ Ἰωύαν, καὶ Ἐλισὰ, καὶ Θοβὲλ, καὶ Μοσὸχ, καὶ Θείρας.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ ፡ ጋሜር ፡ አስ[ካ]ንሶ ፡ ወኢራፌት ፡ ወቲራጋም ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Gamer, Aschanaz, and Riphath, and Thorgama.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Gamer, Aschanaz, and Riphath, and Thorgama.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
translations.ron: Fii lui Gomer au fost: Aşchenaz, Rifat şi Togarma.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Γαμὲρ, Ἀσχανὰζ, καὶ Ῥιφὰθ, καὶ Θοργαμά.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ ፡ ይህያን ፡ ኤልሳ ፡ ወትራሳሶ ፡ ወቂጥኢ ፡ ወሮድኢ ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Jovan, Elisa, and Tharseis, Cetians, Rhodians.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Jovan, Elisa, and Tharseis, Cetians, Rhodians.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
translations.ron: Fii lui Iavan au fost: Elişa, Tarşiş, Chitim şi Dodanim.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰωύαν, Ἐλισὰ, καὶ Θάρσεις, Κήτιοι, Ῥόδὶοι.

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ እሉ ፡ ተፈልጠ ፡ ደሰያቲሆሙ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ በበምድሮሙ ፡ ለለአሐዱ ፡ ወበበነገሮሙ ፡ ወበበነገዶሙ ፡ ወአሕዛቢሆሙ
                  ።
verses.translation: From these were the islands of the Gentiles divided in their land, each according to his tongue, in their tribes and in their nations.

translations.lxx: From these were the islands of the Gentiles divided in their land, each according to his tongue, in their tribes and in their nations.
translations.kjv: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
translations.ron: Din aceştia s-au format mulţime de popoare, care s-au aşezat în diferite ţări, fiecare după limba sa, după neamul său şi după naţia sa.
translations.grk: Ἐκ τούτων ἀφωρίσθησαν νῆσοι τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν· ἕκαστος κατὰ γλῶσσαν ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ ፡ ካም ፡ ኩሳ ፡ ወም[ሴጣሬ]ም ፡ ወፉጥ ፡ ወከናአን ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Cham, Chus, and Mesrain, Phud, and Chanaan.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Cham, Chus, and Mesrain, Phud, and Chanaan.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Ham au fost: Cuş, Miţraim, Put şi Canaan.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ δὲ Χὰμ, Χοὺς, καὶ Μεσραῒν, Φοὺδ, καὶ Χαναάν.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ ፡ ኩሳ ፡ ሶባ ፡ ወኤዌልጥ ፡ [ወሳቤታ ፡] ወሬጌም ፡ ወሰበቃታ ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ሬጌም ፡ ሳባ ፡ ወዮዳዳን ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Chus, Saba, and Evila, and Sabatha, and Rhegma, and Sabathaca. And the sons of Rhegma, Saba, and Dadan.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Chus, Saba, and Evila, and Sabatha, and Rhegma, and Sabathaca. And the sons of Rhegma, Saba, and Dadan.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Cuş au fost: Şeba, Havila, Savta, Rama şi Sabteca. Fiii lui Rama au fost: Şeba şi Dedan.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ δὲ Χοὺς, Σαβὰ, καὶ Εὐϊλὰ, καὶ Σαβαθὰ, καὶ Ῥεγμὰ, καὶ Σαβαθακά· υἱοὶ δὲ Ῥεγμὰ, Σαβὰ, καὶ Δαδάν.

verses.geez: ወኩሳ ፡ ወለዶ ፡ ለኑቤርድ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ዘኮነ ፡ ያርብሐ ፡ በምድር ።
verses.translation: And Chus begot Nebrod: he began to be a giant upon the earth.

translations.lxx: And Chus begot Nebrod: he began to be a giant upon the earth.
translations.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
translations.ron: Cuş a mai născut de asemenea pe Nimrod; acesta a fost cel dint i viteaz pe păm nt.
translations.grk: Χοὺς δὲ ἐγέννησε τὸν Νεβρώδ· οὗτος ἤρξατο εἶναι γίγας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ነዓዌ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ ከመ ፡ [ኑቤርድ ፡] ያርብሕ ፡ ዘኮነ ፡ ነዓዌ
                  ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: He was a giant hunter before the Lord God; therefore they say, As Nebrod the giant hunter before the Lord.

translations.lxx: He was a giant hunter before the Lord God; therefore they say, As Nebrod the giant hunter before the Lord.
translations.kjv: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
translations.ron: El a fost v nător vestit naintea Domnului Dumnezeu; de aceea se şi zice: V nător vestit ca Nimrod naintea Domnului Dumnezeu
translations.grk: Οὗτος ἦν γίγας κυνηγὸς ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ· διὰ τοῦτο ἐροῦσιν, ὡς Νεβρὼδ γίγας κυνηγὸς ἐναντίον Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ወኮነ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ መንግሥቱ ፡ ባቢሎን ፡ ወ[ኦሬክ] ፡ ወአርከድ ፡ ወካሌን ፡ በምድረ ፡ ሰናአር ።
verses.translation: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Orech, and Archad, and Chalanne, in the land of Senaar.

translations.lxx: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Orech, and Archad, and Chalanne, in the land of Senaar.
translations.kjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
translations.ron: mpărăţia lui, la nceput, o alcătuia: Babilonul, apoi Ereh, Acad şi Calne din ţinutul Senaar.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἀρχὴ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ Βαβυλὼν, καὶ Ὀρὲχ, καὶ Ἀρχὰδ, καὶ Χαλάννη, ἐν τῇ γῇ Σεναάρ.

verses.geez: ወእምይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወጽአ ፡ አሶር ፡ ወነደቃ ፡ ለነነዌ ፡ ወለሮቤት ፡ ሀገር ፡ ዐባይ ።
verses.translation: Out of that land came Assur, and built Ninevi, and the city Rhooboth, and Chalach,

translations.lxx: Out of that land came Assur, and built Ninevi, and the city Rhooboth, and Chalach,
translations.kjv: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
translations.ron: Din păm ntul acela, el trecu n Asur, unde a zidit Ninive, cetatea Rehobot, Calah
translations.grk: Ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐκείνης ἐξῆλθεν Ἀσσούρ· καὶ ᾠκοδόμησε τὴν Νινευῒ, καὶ τὴν Ῥοωβὼθ πόλιν, καὶ τὴν Χαλὰχ,

verses.geez: ወምሴጣሬም ፡ ወለዶሙ ፡ ለ[ሉ]ድኬም ፡ ወለ[ኤኔ]ማጠአም ፡ ወለ[ለቢአም] ፡ ወለንፍታሌም ፤
verses.translation: And Mesrain begot the Ludiim, and the Nephthalim, and the Enemetiim, and the Labiim,

translations.lxx: And Mesrain begot the Ludiim, and the Nephthalim, and the Enemetiim, and the Labiim,
translations.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
translations.ron: Din Miţraim s-au născut: Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naftuhim,
translations.grk: Καὶ Μεσραῒν ἐγέννησε τοὺς Λουδιεὶμ, καὶ τοὺς Νεφθαλεὶμ, καὶ τοὺς Ἐνεμετιεὶμ, καὶ τοὺς Λαβιεὶμ,

verses.geez: ወለጴ[ጥሮ]ሶናኦን ፡ ወለከሳሮ[ኦ]ን ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ወጽአ ፡ ፌሌሴጤአም ፡ ወለቃፍ[ቶርአ]ም ።
verses.translation: and the Patrosoniim, and the Chasmoniim (whence came forth Phylistiim) and the Gaphthoriim.

translations.lxx: and the Patrosoniim, and the Chasmoniim (whence came forth Phylistiim) and the Gaphthoriim.
translations.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
translations.ron: Patrusim, Casluhim - de unde au ieşit Filistenii - şi Caftorim.
translations.grk: καὶ τοὺς Πατροσωνιεὶμ, καὶ τοὺς Χασμωνιεὶμ, ὅθεν ἐξῆλθε Φυλιστιεὶμ, καὶ τοὺς Γαφθοριείμ.

verses.geez: ወከናአን ፡ ወለዶ ፡ ለሲዶን ፡ [በኵሩ ፡] ወለኪጢኤን ።
verses.translation: And Chanaan begot Sidon his first-born, and the Chettite,

translations.lxx: And Chanaan begot Sidon his first-born, and the Chettite,
translations.kjv: And Canaan begat Sidon his first born, and Heth,
translations.ron: Din Canaan s-au născut: Sidon, nt iul-născut al său, apoi Het,
translations.grk: Χαναὰν δὲ ἐγέννησε τὸν Σιδῶνα πρωτότοκον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸν Χετταῖον,

verses.geez: [ወለኢያቡሴዎን ፡ ወለአሞሬዎን ፡ ወለጌርጌሴዎን ።
verses.translation: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

translations.lxx: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
translations.kjv: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
translations.ron: Iebuseu, Amoreu, Ghergheseu,
translations.grk: καὶ τὸν Ἰεβουσαῖον, καὶ τὸν Ἀμοῤῥαῖον, καὶ τὸν Γεργεσαῖον,

verses.geez: ወለኤዌዎን ፡] ወለዔሬቄዎን ፡ ወለአሰ[ኔዎ]ን ።
verses.translation: and the Evite, and the Arukite, and the Asennite,

translations.lxx: and the Evite, and the Arukite, and the Asennite,
translations.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
translations.ron: Heveu, Archeu, Sineu,
translations.grk: καὶ τὸν Εὐαῖον, καὶ τὸν Ἀρουκαῖον, καὶ τὸν Ἀσενναῖον,

verses.geez: ወለከራዱአን ፡ ወለሰማንኢር ፡ ወለአመቲ ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ተዘርዉ ፡ ከናአን ።
verses.translation: and the Aradian, and the Samarean, and the Amathite; and after this the tribes of the Chananites were dispersed.

translations.lxx: and the Aradian, and the Samarean, and the Amathite; and after this the tribes of the Chananites were dispersed.
translations.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
translations.ron: Arvadeu, Ãžemareu şi Hamateu. Mai pe urmă neamurile canaaneiene s-au răsp ndit.
translations.grk: καὶ τον Ἀράδιον, καὶ τὸν Σαμαραῖον, καὶ τὸν Ἀμαθί. Καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο διεσπάρησαν αἱ φυλαὶ τῶν Χαναναίων.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ አድባሪሆሙ ፡ ለከናአን ፡ እምነ ፡ [ሲዶን ፡ እስከ ፡] ጌራራ ፡ ወጋዛን ፡ ወይበጽሕ ፡ ሶዶም ፡ ወጎሞራ ፡
                  ወ[አ]ዶማ ፡ ወሰቤዮ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሴላ ።
verses.translation: And the boundaries of the Chananites were from Sidon till one comes to Gerara and Gaza, till one comes to Sodom and Gomorrha, Adama and Seboim, as far as Dasa.

translations.lxx: And the boundaries of the Chananites were from Sidon till one comes to Gerara and Gaza, till one comes to Sodom and Gomorrha, Adama and Seboim, as far as Dasa.
translations.kjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
translations.ron: Şi ţinuturile lor se ntindeau de la Sidon, spre Gherara p nă la Gaza, iar de aici spre Sodoma, Gomora, Adma şi Ãžeboim p nă spre Lasa.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια τῶν Χαναναίων ἀπὸ Σιδῶνος ἕως ἐλθεῖν εἰς Γεραρὰ καὶ Γαζὰν, ἕως ἐλθεῖν ἕως Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόῤῥας, Ἀδαμὰ καὶ Σεβωῒμ ἕως Δασά.

verses.geez: ወእሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ለካም ፡ በበዘመዶሙ ፡ ወበበነገሮሙ ፡ ወበበብሔሮሙ ፡ ወአሕዛቤሆሙ ።
verses.translation: These were the sons of Cham in their tribes according to their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

translations.lxx: These were the sons of Cham in their tribes according to their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
translations.ron: Aceştia sunt fiii lui Ham, după familii, limbă, ţări şi după naţii.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι υἱοὶ Χὰμ, ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν, κατὰ γλώσσας αὐτῶν, ἐν ταῖς χώραις αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወለሴምኒ ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤቤር ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለያፌት ፡ ለዘየዐቢ ።
verses.translation: And to Sem himself also were children born, the father of all the sons of Heber, the brother of Japheth the elder.

translations.lxx: And to Sem himself also were children born, the father of all the sons of Heber, the brother of Japheth the elder.
translations.kjv: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
translations.ron: De asemenea i s-au născut fii şi lui Sem, tatăl tuturor fiilor lui Eber şi fratele mai mare al lui Iafet.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ Σὴμ ἐγεννήθη καὶ αὐτῷ πατρὶ πάντων τῶν υἱῶν Ἕβερ, ἀδελφῷ Ἰάφεθ τοῦ μείζονος.

verses.geez: ወልደ ፡ ሴም ፡ ኤላም ፡ ወአሶር ፡ ወአርፋክ[ሳ]ድ ፡ [ወሉድ ፡ ወአራም ።
verses.translation: Sons of Sem, Elam, and Assur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Cainan.

translations.lxx: Sons of Sem, Elam, and Assur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Cainan.
translations.kjv: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Sem au fost: Elam, Asur, Arfaxad, Lud şi Aram.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σὴμ, Ἐλὰμ, καὶ Ἀσσοὺρ, καὶ Ἀρφαξὰδ, καὶ Λοὺδ, καὶ Ἀρὰμ, καὶ Καϊνᾶν.

verses.geez: ወደቂቀ ፡ አራም ፡ ኤሳሕ ፡] ወዮምኤል ፡ ወያቲር ፡ ወሞሶሕ ።
verses.translation: And sons of Aram, Uz, and Ul, and Gater, and Mosoch.

translations.lxx: And sons of Aram, Uz, and Ul, and Gater, and Mosoch.
translations.kjv: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Aram au fost: Uţ, Hul, Gheter şi Maş.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀρὰμ, Οὒζ, καὶ Οὒλ, καὶ Γατὲρ, καὶ Μοσόχ.

verses.geez: ወአርፋክ[ሳ]ድ ፡ ወለዶ ፡ ለሳላ ፡ ወሳላ ፡ ወለዶ ፡ ለኤቤ[ር] ።
verses.translation: And Arphaxad begot Cainan, and Cainan begot Sala. And Sala begot Heber.

translations.lxx: And Arphaxad begot Cainan, and Cainan begot Sala. And Sala begot Heber.
translations.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
translations.ron: Lui Arfaxad i s-a născut Cainan; lui Cainan i s-a născut Şelah; lui Şelah i s-a născut Eber;
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἀρφαξὰδ ἐγέννησε τὸν Καϊνᾶν, καὶ Καϊνᾶν ἐγέννησε τὸν Σαλά· Σαλὰ δὲ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἕβερ.

verses.geez:
ወለኤቤ[ር] ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለአሐዱ ፡ ፋሌግ ፡ እስመ ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ ፡ ተከፍለት ፡ ምድር ፡ ወስመ
                  ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ዮቃጤን ።
verses.translation: And to Heber were born two sons, the name of the one, Phaleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother Jektan.

translations.lxx: And to Heber were born two sons, the name of the one, Phaleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and the name of his brother Jektan.
translations.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
translations.ron: Iar lui Eber i s-au născut doi fii: numele unuia era Peleg, pentru că n zilele lui s-a mpărţit păm ntul, şi numele fratelui său era Ioctan.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ Ἕβερ ἐγεννήθησαν δύο υἱοί· ὄνομα τῷ ἑνὶ, Φαλὲγ, ὅτι ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ διεμερίσθη ἡ γῆ· καὶ ὄνομα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ Ἰεκτάν.

verses.geez: ወዮቃጤን ፡ ወለዶ ፡ ለእልሞዳድ ፡ ወለሴሌፋ ፡ ወለሴራሞት ፡ ወለ[ኤ]ራኅ ፤
verses.translation: And Jektan begot Elmodad, and Saleth, and Sarmoth, and Jarach,

translations.lxx: And Jektan begot Elmodad, and Saleth, and Sarmoth, and Jarach,
translations.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
translations.ron: Lui Ioctan i s-au născut Almodad, Şalef, Haţarmavet şi Ierah;
translations.grk: Ἰεκτὰν δὲ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ἐλμωδὰδ, καὶ Σαλὲθ, καὶ τὸν Σαρμὼθ, καὶ Ἰαρὰχ,

verses.geez: ወለሖዶራ ፡ ወለኤዜላ ፡ ወለዴቄላ ፤
verses.translation: and Odorrha, and Aibel, and Decla,

translations.lxx: and Odorrha, and Aibel, and Decla,
translations.kjv: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
translations.ron: Hadoram, Uzal şi Dicla;
translations.grk: καὶ Ὁδοῤῥὰ, καὶ Αἰβὴλ, καὶ Δεκλὰ, καὶ Εὐὰλ,

verses.geez: [ወለኡባላ ፡] ወለአ[ቢማኤል] ፡ ወለ[ሳባ] ፤ ወለሑፋር ፡
verses.translation: and Eval, and Abimael, and Saba,

translations.lxx: and Eval, and Abimael, and Saba,
translations.kjv: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
translations.ron: Obal, Abimael şi Şeba;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀβιμαὲλ, καὶ Σαβὰ,

verses.geez: [ወለሄዊላ ፡] ወለኢዮቦር ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ለዮቃጤን ።
verses.translation: and Uphir, and Evila, and Jobab, all these were the sons of Jektan.

translations.lxx: and Uphir, and Evila, and Jobab, all these were the sons of Jektan.
translations.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
translations.ron: Ofir, Havila şi Iobab. Toţi aceştia au fost fiii lui Ioctan.
translations.grk: καὶ Οὐφεὶρ, καὶ Εὑεϊλὰ, καὶ Ἰωβάβ· πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἰεκτάν.

verses.geez: ወኮነ ፡ ምንባራቲሆሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማሴ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሳፈራ ፡ ይበጽሕ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ሠረቃዌ ።
verses.translation: And their dwelling was from Masse, till one comes to Saphera, a mountain of the east.

translations.lxx: And their dwelling was from Masse, till one comes to Saphera, a mountain of the east.
translations.kjv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
translations.ron: Sălaşurile lor se ntindeau de la Meşa spre Sefar, p nă la Muntele Răsăritului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ κατοίκησις αὐτῶν, ἀπὸ Μασσῆ ἕως ἐλθεῖν εἰς Σαφηρὰ ὄρος ἀνατολῶν.

verses.geez: እሉ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ለሴም ፡ በበ(ዘመዶሙ ፡ ወ)ነገዶሙ ፡ ወበበ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ብሔሮሙ ፡ ወበበአዝማዲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: These were the sons of Sem in their tribes, according to their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

translations.lxx: These were the sons of Sem in their tribes, according to their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
translations.ron: Aceştia sunt fiii lui Sem după familii, după limbă, după ţări şi după naţii.
translations.grk: Οὗτοι υἱοὶ Σὴμ, ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν, κατὰ γλώσσας αὐτῶν, ἐν ταῖς χώραις αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወዛቲ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ለኖኅ ፡ በበዘመዶሙ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ እሉ ፡ ተወልደ ፡ ዘተዘርወ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ አይኅ
                  ።
verses.translation: These are the tribes of the sons of Noe, according to their generations, according to their nations: of them were the islands of the Gentiles scattered over the earth after the flood.

translations.lxx: These are the tribes of the sons of Noe, according to their generations, according to their nations: of them were the islands of the Gentiles scattered over the earth after the flood.
translations.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
translations.ron: Acestea sunt neamurile, care se trag din fiii lui Noe, după familii şi după naţii, şi dintr- nşii s-au răsp ndit popoarele pe păm nt după potop.
translations.grk: Αὗται αἱ φυλαὶ υἱῶν Νῶε κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν, κατὰ ἔθνη αὐτῶν· ἀπὸ τούτων διεσπάρησαν νῆσοι τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς μετὰ τὸν κατακλυσμόν.
